evidence: The routine takes a 32-bit selector in x0, clears/initializes the selected RTTS global data and helper objects, then calls 0x700042e050 and 0x700042ea40 to load Relationship.xml configuration and PassiveRelationships.xml data. Those helpers resolve frontend//rtts//Relationship.xml and frontend//rtts//PassiveRelationships.xml at full guest addresses (their bodies are at decompiled/main/main_0032.c:29639-30336 and :30337-32039). Two indexed callers pass selector 0 and 1 from the RTTS initialization sequences at decompiled/main/main_0033.c:46029 and :49852. Target body: decompiled/main/main_0032.c:29282-29420. The broad label describes the observed setup and does not claim a specific original symbol.
